> 第3章 杨康2（第1页）
最后不知道完颜洪烈怎么和包惜弱说的，完颜洪烈倒是没在拒绝，毕竟在他看来，这是全真教向他大金服软了。
包惜弱对此倒是很开心，自家儿子能和昔日的故人有交集，自己也算对的起铁哥了！
杨康对于这个发展简直不知道该说什么好！就丘处机那明晃晃的厌恶，政治斗争走出来的完颜洪烈看不出来吗？妥妥一个恋爱脑啊！
这要是自己没篡改记忆，完颜洪烈估计更疯！
为了自己以后能够摆脱丘处机，杨康果断进宫寻求自家祖母的庇护！
你想教我武功，我就不信你敢擅闯皇宫！
是的，完颜洪烈的母亲还好好活着呢！这要不是自家儿子非要娶，她绝不会同意包惜弱嫁给自家儿子！
在她看来，包惜弱长得一般，整日愁眉苦脸，身份还是宋人，也不知道自家儿子到底看上她什么了！
不过杨康倒是多想了，丘处机可没有那个功夫教导他，扔下一本初浅的内功心法就直接走了，毕竟在金人的地盘上他难受！
而且他还要除暴安良，匡扶大宋，没有功夫在这里耗着，能留下心法就是教导了！
等杨康知道丘处机的操作，嘴角不由抽了抽，他明白原着里面杨康的功夫为什么只有梅超风教导的九阴真经了。
就丘处机这操作，杨康估计连他面都见不了几次，每次见面还挑刺骂人，这要是能教导出好结果，那只能说杨康是天纵奇才！
丘处机最后的收徒之旅只能说是似是而非！
毕竟杨康可没有敬拜师茶，这严格来说，根本都没有成功拜师！至于丘处机留下的心法，杨康连看都没看，直接扔到了一边，他才看不上这个呢！
时间倒是就这么慢慢的过着，转眼就是十几年。包惜弱依旧怀念着自己的亡夫，完颜洪烈倒是痴心，但也没有放弃在朝堂上大展宏图。
丘处机倒是来过几次，每次都问包惜弱杨康的学习情况，包惜弱都说有好好教导。
丘处机听完就走了，倒也没有再和杨康见过！
但包惜弱只是一介妇人，平时对杨康又不闻不问，只顾着自己伤春悲秋，哪里知道杨康根本就没有学呢！

说到底包惜弱之所以能一心一意的在茅草屋怀念亡夫，不过是因为物质条件不缺，儿子有人照顾，借着怀念亡夫的名头，心安理得的享受着完颜洪烈带来的一切罢了！
完颜洪烈对丘处机本身就看不上，只是让人把东西给了杨康。在他心里，自家儿子就是一等一的勤奋好学，完全不需要费心！
只能说他们几个都太相信对方，对杨康都不上心，导致这样的偏差，不过这对杨康来说倒是好事，他还不愿意见呢！
其他人倒是没什么变化，郭靖依旧成为金刀驸马，黄蓉也离家出走，欧阳克也应邀前来赵王府。
杨康看着即将到来的剧情，心里倒是十分期待，这些年他在大金朝堂上也有了一定的话语权，皇帝对他倒是十分信任！他倒要看看这次有他的加入，剧情能偏到哪里！

> Chapter 3 Yang Kang 2 (Page 1)
In the end, I don’t know what Wanyan Honglie told Bao Xiruo. Wanyan Honglie didn’t refuse. After all, in his opinion, this was the Quanzhen Sect’s submission to him.
Bao Xiruo was very happy about this. His son could interact with an old friend from the past, and he was right with Brother Tie!
Yang Kang simply didn’t know what to say about this development! Qiu Chuji's obvious disgust, couldn't Wanyan Honglie, who had emerged from the political struggle, see it? What a love brain!
If he hadn't tampered with his memory, Wanyan Honglie would have been even crazier!
In order to get rid of Qiu Chuji in the future, Yang Kang decisively entered the palace to seek the protection of his grandmother!
You want to teach me martial arts, but I don’t believe you dare to break into the palace!
Yes, Wanyan Honglie’s mother is still alive and well! If her son hadn't insisted on marrying her, she would never have agreed to Bao Xiruo marrying her son!
In her opinion, Bao Xiruo looks average, has a sad face all day long, and is from the Song Dynasty. She doesn't know what her son likes about her!
However, Yang Kang thought too much. Qiu Chuji didn't have the skills to teach him, so he threw down a copy of Chuqian's internal skills and mental methods and left directly. After all, he felt uncomfortable in the Jinren's territory!
Moreover, he also wanted to eradicate violence and help the Song Dynasty. He had no time to waste here. If he could leave his thoughts behind, it would be teaching!
When Yang Kang learned about Qiu Chuji's operation, the corner of his mouth couldn't help but twitch. He understood why Yang Kang's only Kung Fu in the original work was the Jiuyin Sutra taught by Mei Chaofeng.
Regarding Qiu Chuji's behavior, Yang Kang probably didn't even meet him a few times, and he would criticize and criticize him every time he met. If this kind of teaching can produce good results, then it can only be said that Yang Kang is a genius!
Qiu Chuji's final journey to become a disciple can only be described as specious!
After all, Yang Kang did not worship his master Cha Cha. Strictly speaking, he did not succeed in becoming a master at all! As for the mental method left by Qiu Chuji, Yang Kang didn't even look at it and just threw it aside. He didn't like this!
Time passed by so slowly, and it was more than ten years in the blink of an eye. Bao Xiruo still missed her late husband, while Wanyan Honglie was infatuated with him, but he did not give up on displaying his ambitions in the court.
Qiu Chuji came here several times, and every time he asked Bao Xiruo about Yang Kang's study, Bao Xiruo always said that he taught him well.
After hearing this, Qiu Chuji left and never saw Yang Kang again!
But Bao Xiruo was just a woman. She usually ignored Yang Kang and only cared about her own sorrow. How could she know that Yang Kang had not learned anything at all?
In the final analysis, the reason why Bao Xiruo could wholeheartedly remember her late husband in that thatched house was because he had adequate material conditions and his son was taken care of. By using the name of remembering his late husband, he could enjoy everything that Wanyan Honglie brought with peace of mind!
Wanyan Honglie didn't like Qiu Chuji himself, so he just asked people to give the things to Yang Kang. In his mind, his son is a first-class diligent and studious person, so there is no need to worry at all!
It can only be said that they all trust each other too much and don't care about Yang Kang, which leads to such a deviation. However, this is a good thing for Yang Kang, and he doesn't want to see him yet!
There were no changes for the others. Guo Jing still became the Golden Sword Consort, Huang Rong also ran away from home, and Ouyang Ke was also invited to Prince Zhao's Mansion.
Yang Kang looked forward to the upcoming plot and was looking forward to it. Over the years, he had gained a certain say in the Dajin Court, and the emperor trusted him very much! He wanted to see where the plot would go with him joining this time!
